cohort: Infants born at >=36 weeks of gestation (n=500) with moderate or severe HIE, enrolled in the High-dose Erythropoietin for Asphyxia and Encephalopathy Trial.
finding: Combined acute and chronic placental abnormalities were common in infants with HIE, with chronic abnormalities associated with a greater base deficit at birth and acute abnormalities linked to older gestational ages and higher rates of clinical chorioamnionitis.
